title: Exoskeleton
move_pattern: Moves depend on creature slot position. Slot 1 starts with Skitter, Slot 2 with Mandibles, Slot 3 with Enrage, Slot 4 with random selection. After initial move, follows cycle: Mandibles → Enrage → random (Skitter/Mandibles), with Skitter → random.
notes: Behavior varies based on creature slot in multi-enemy encounters. Multiple Exoskeletons will have different opening moves depending on their slot position, but all eventually cycle through similar patterns.
